claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Dofetilide is a high-affinity hERG (KCNH2) potassium channel blocker; at 2.5 uM this is expected to have little effect on most cancer cell lines, with any killing restricted to lines whose proliferation depends on hERG currents.
